# Assistant
[color=#9fed58]Assistants[/color] are currently limited to late-joining members, with no special accesses or tools to begin. This doesn't mean you don't have responsibility though! Every Assistant still spawns with a [textlink="Secret Identity" link="OrganizationsAndSecretIdentities"] and objectives to fulfill of their own!
Follow your objectives and help your team to make an impact, or use the opportunity to observe the game while helping from the background.
## Other Tips - Your ID only has basic accesses, so getting a new one from the [textlink="Station Admin" link="Station Admin"] or finding one on the ground or a body can help tremendously - Try to find some people to connect with, friendliness can go a long way. - Dead players can't come back, so tools or equipment they had in life might help you in yours. - If you feel comfortable, try help where you can. Maybe a fellow traitor is locked in a room or crew are busy and can't take care of an AME clog, which is where you can keep yourself busy. - If the round is young, try observe what other jobs do, so next round you can pick one up. Start small if you want!
